description: Free. The pump.fun coins with the most SOL flowing in over the trailing window (6 hours by default; 1h and 12h too), among coins whose first-10-second buyers took under 30% of the supply, with under 30% dust trades, a real float and no launch-slot buyout. Two lanes: new (launched inside the window, curve not finished) and hot (any age). Each coin with its net SOL in, the wallets that bought in the window (not holders), largest buy, market cap now, age and early concentration, and the list's own backtest (most listed coins were below their listed price an hour later). For: what is trending on pump.fun, what is hot right now, new coins with money coming in. Not a recommendation; then check_coin on a mint.
name: trending
